description: This PHP class defines the DefaultTimesheetModel that serializes Timesheet entities into a structured array, including their start and end dates, IDs, and statuses, for use in API responses within the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes Timesheet data into an API-friendly format, including ID, status, start date, and end date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Timesheet entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the Timesheet entity into an associative array including IDs, status, start and end dates for API output.
